input:
CURRENT SCENE:
因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

ITEMS:

[I149] 因为他们常常搬【了】家   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: habitual action with 常常 does not take 了
  rule card (cause_result_soyi, Coherence: connectors): Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the following event is not a result of the preceding clause, so 所以 is not appropriate; use <connector> / delete it.  Her terms: 这样, 结果, 后来
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 他们[搬了家两次→搬了两次家] — her note: V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
  her past correction: 所以他们再[搬家一次→搬了一次家] — her note: 了completed

[I150] 【孟母】三迁   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟母: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在一起 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧跟妈妈一起住在西安 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在小的城 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I151] 妈妈教孟子很多【技能】   correction: 技能 → 东西   strength: suggestion
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: [-孟子的妈妈]告诉孟子 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈不是工作就是试一试[帮助她的儿子孟子→辅导儿子孟子]
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈[不是轻松的妈妈，而且她是厉害的妈妈→在教育方面很厉害] — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong

[I152] 【先她】让孟子跟朋友玩儿   correction: 先她 → 她先   strength: error
  checker's note: the subject comes before 先
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧不是跟朋友玩 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子老是想[玩玩→玩] — her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
  her past correction: [-孟子老是]想玩玩

[I153] 然后教他怎么买又便宜【^】又好质量的东西   correction: ∅ → 质量   strength: suggestion
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 她跟孟子常常[去买东西在城市→去城市买东西]
  her past correction: 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction: 然后写[+下了]他学了什么

[I154] 然后教他怎么买又便宜又【好质量】的东西   correction: 好质量 → 质量好   strength: error
  checker's note: quality adjective order is reversed
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 她跟孟子常常[去买东西在城市→去城市买东西]
  her past correction: 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction: [常常祭拜以后，→常常在祭拜以后]孟子和他的妈妈一起去买东西

items.explanation: With 常常, this is a habitual action, so do not use 了completed.
孟母 appears for the first time here, so please briefly introduce her, for example as 孟子的妈妈.
It would be more natural to say 东西 here. 技能 is less natural for the things a mother teaches him to buy.
Put the subject before 先: 她先让孟子跟朋友玩儿.
It would be more natural to add 质量: 又便宜又质量好 describes both the price and the quality.
Say 质量好, with the noun 质量 before 好.
